name: Qwen3-Nemotron-32B-RLBFF
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-32B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, uniform full attention on all 64 layers (no sliding window, no hybrid)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. An RL-from-feedback post-train of Qwen/Qwen3-32B (RLBFF, NVIDIA research model), not a new base model: config.json unchanged, safetensors total 32,762,123,264 params - the base record carries the declared 32B label, so the 0.762B gap is label-vs-file, not extra weights. Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2025-10-12. CAVEATS: MT Bench is a GPT-4-Turbo-judged 10-point score, recorded at scale 10 rather than converted to 100. Card does not print shot counts or thinking on/off for these three rows.
